extensionDescription.message: Correct Chinese and Japanese font selection and bold matching in Linux Chromium while preserving website Latin fonts.

unavailableHelp.message: Browser-protected and unsupported pages do not allow its page script to run.

settingsSubtitle.message: Choose fonts for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese, and control how page language is detected.

simpleModeLabel.message: Simple mode: set the page language only

simpleModeHelp.message: When a page opens, detect its language and set its lang so the browser can choose a suitable font. Later content changes are not rechecked.

simpleModeNotice.message: Simple mode uses browser and operating system fonts. To choose fonts yourself, turn off Simple mode.

fontWarning.message: No Sans font is selected. Choose an installed Sans font for at least one language.

defaultChineseHelp.message: Used when the extension cannot determine whether the page's Chinese text is Simplified or Traditional.

trustCjkLang.message: Trust specific Chinese and Japanese language declarations

trustCjkLangHelp.message: When content has lang=zh-CN, zh-TW, zh-HK, or ja, use the browser's font choice and leave that content's fonts unchanged.

preserveWebFonts.message: Keep suitable Chinese/Japanese fonts loaded by the website

preserveKnownCjk.message: Keep suitable installed Chinese/Japanese fonts named by the website

dynamicDetectionHelp.message: When disabled, the initial result stays fixed.

mixedLanguageDetection.message: Detect clearly separated Chinese and Japanese text blocks (experimental)

mixedLanguageDetectionHelp.message: Only activates on pages with substantial amounts of both languages and no explicit CJK lang.

fontListEmpty.message: The browser returned an empty font list.

siteOverridesHelp.message: View and edit languages selected for individual websites. These settings are not changed by Restore defaults.

invalidWebsite.message: Enter a valid hostname or URL.
